when you're a food blogger + mama of 3, a super functional kitchen is EVERYTHING! I'm truly so so grateful for this space that I've been dreaming about forever! ❤️⁣

big shoutout to @monogramappliances for outfitting my kitchen with the highest quality, most beautiful appliances I've EVER owned. #ad⁣
⁣
a little more info about my fav features:⁣
1. no-hands trash drawer: one press with my knee and it easily pops open — great for when I'm baking or making a recipe with meat and don't want to get the handle all yucky⁣
2. appliance garage: love this so my counters stay nice and clear for prep space⁣
3. knife drawer: I'm obsessed!!⁣
4. Monogram double oven: I have the dual fuel 48" range and it made hosting thanksgiving a breeze ❤️ from the moment I saw it I knew it was the one I needed in my kitchen — so beautiful!⁣
5. hidden nooks beside my stovetop: I love these for salt cellars, pepper grinder, olive oil, etc! comes very much in handy⁣
⁣
any questions about my kitchen? appliance recommendations? design choices I made? I'm planning on making this a little series and can't wait to answer any your q's!⁣

reels.caption:
Roger built me my dream library, and it is one of our favorite rooms in our home! 📚Comment "LIBRARY" for decor details in your DM.

Whenever little Roger Dale disappears, I am sure to find him sitting on the sofa "reading."

By the end of the day, there are piles of books on the sofa (little Roger) and the floor (Sabrina).

There are so many beautiful and fun additions to this library, it's hard to choose my favorite.

From the arches on the bookshelf, to the sliding library ladder (which is kept hidden behind the library French doors so our littles can't get into mischiff), the Jungle Cruise Radio (my FIL gifted this to me as he knows it's my favorite ride; it even plays the music that you hear while standing in line for the ride) to the fireplace screen (attached to the fireplace so Sabrina can't pull it down on herself), and the flower rug (which Roger found for me) to the retro CD player.
Oh, and we can't forget the butterfly bookends and, of course, the cordless book lamps!

I can't wait for the sun to start going down earlier so we can spend more time in our library reading by the soft glow of these book lights!
📚Comment "library" to get all the details in your DM.
